apps.name: Bitcoin Dashboard
apps.description: Watch-only Bitcoin network and address monitoring with a preserved CAD price chart.
apps.compatibility_notes: Requires Python 3.8+ and Tkinter; shared Tor uses Shell API v1 and SOCKS5 remote DNS. October 3 managed removal/reinstall, keyboard lifecycle and offline cached/error states passed. Fresh Tor/API data remained unavailable during the audit.

apps.name: Calculator
apps.description: Decimal arithmetic, parentheses and keyboard navigation for PocketCHIP.
apps.compatibility_notes: Requires Python 3.11+ and system Tkinter. October 3 PocketCHIP managed removal/reinstall, keyboard/pointer arithmetic, Home/resume and offline exit passed. Physical input and synchronized scanout remain unverified.

apps.name: System Monitor
apps.description: Monitor CPU, memory, storage, temperature, GPU, network and processes, with optional diagnostics.
apps.compatibility_notes: Requires Linux, Python 3.11+ and system Tk. Optional EGL Pulse needs X11/XWayland, EGL/GLES2 and hardware drivers. October 3 managed lifecycle passed for 0.4.0; 0.4.1 network-counter source repair was exercised on-device. GPU utilization accuracy remains unresolved.

apps.name: Firefly Field
apps.description: A calm, fullscreen pixel-art firefly meadow rendered through SDL2.
apps.compatibility_notes: Requires Python 3.8+ and system SDL2 2.0+ with a video driver; SDL 2.0.18+ enables sprite batching. October 3 managed lifecycle passed for 0.3.1; 0.3.2 packing source was compared on-device. Low FPS and physical synchronized scanout remain unresolved.

apps.name: Places
apps.description: A native first-person exploration game through an office, empty pool and unfinished interior on PocketCHIP.
apps.compatibility_notes: Requires PocketCHIP ARMv7 hard-float Linux, glibc 2.36+, SDL2 2.32+, Mali/Lima OpenGL ES 2.0 and X11. Trust csd113/Places in Details. October 3 managed removal/reinstall, movement, pause, Home/resume and offline exit passed while settings/cache were preserved. Injected-fault Repair remains unverified.

apps.name: Vitrallis Media Carousel
apps.description: Native media slideshow with LAN uploads, named collections and shared settings.
apps.compatibility_notes: Requires Python 3.9+, Tk 8.6, Pillow >=10.4,<13 and qrcode >=7.4,<9. Optional system ffmpeg/ffprobe; one-click setup needs the Shell multimedia helper. October 3 managed lifecycle passed for 0.4.3; the 0.4.4 source repair produced VP8 frames and exited on-device. Cold startup remains slow; physical scanout is unverified.

apps.name: Music
apps.description: Browse local music, play tracks, and view song information and album artwork.
apps.compatibility_notes: Requires Python 3.11+, Tk 8.6, Pillow >=10.4,<13 and system ffplay/ffprobe/ffmpeg. October 3 managed lifecycle passed for 0.1.0; 0.1.1 source passed 25 native tests including four real formats and parent-death cleanup. Audible speaker output remains unverified.

apps.name: Sketch
apps.description: Draw with touch or keys, undo strokes, and save lossless PNG sketches.
apps.compatibility_notes: Requires Python 3.11+, Tk 8.6 and Pillow >=10.4,<13. October 3 managed removal/reinstall, keyboard/pointer drawing, PNG save/open, Home/resume and offline exit passed. Native 17-test suite passed; physical touch and scanout remain unverified.
